messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Defining items with cross loading in the model
parts: Your model is likely not statistically identified. You have few unique indicators (associated with only one common factor). In particular, factor B has no unique indicators, while A and C have only 1 unique indicator each. Indicators 4 and 6 load on THREE different common factors, which is rare in application. Generally, indicators loading on multiple factors this requires that factors be mutually orthogonal, and may also require starting values provided by the researcher. But you want to run a regression among these factors, so you can't make them orthogonal. If you want this to work, you will need other variables which distinguish the different common factors.
